text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking in front of the
station...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like I just said, the glass was already
broken when
we arrived!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
Quit your lying mouth! I've heard
enough from
you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! You stubborn old man! Why don't
you
wanna believe us?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh... But seriously, it wasn't us who broke the window.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
Huh, won't bother to show any remorse,
will you?
You're as disrespectful as you
look! Young people
these days...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hold up. Can you, like, not make snap judgments based on how we look?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That one ticked Gold City off. Things
can only
get worse from here!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Trainer?! What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's not like we needed you to swoop in
and save
us...
choice_data_list: 君が困っていそうだったから
貴方が困っていそうだったから

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Talk about lucky! I will happily let you take over here. ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, get real. Times like these, you
just gotta
let the grown-ups talk it out.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh... So you are the guardian of these
children?
How are you going to pay for
my broken window?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you apologizing for?!
choice_data_list: この度は誠に申し訳ございません

text_block_list.name: Elderly Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text: Check? Check what?
choice_data_list: 責任は取りますが、確認もさせてください

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After waiting for the owner to calm
down, we
look around the area and ask
a few bystanders
some questions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, someone at a nearby coffee
shop
witnessed the moment the incident
happened.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
So it was those local brats who broke the
window!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry for all the trouble.
Thank you for
your help sorting this out.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
I should apologize to you two as well. It
was
childish of me to get so worked
up—I wasn't
listening properly to what
you said.
choice_data_list: 真犯人が見つかってよかったです

text_block_list.name: Elderly Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
I convinced myself you were lying. I
should have
done better... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're good! See, City? I knew it was
the right
call to let your trainer take
over! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's not fair...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's not fair you can just stroll in saying
"guardian"
this and "responsibility" that,
and then the whole
thing is just fixed.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But you did help us out, so...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about earlier. I'm glad you were
there.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You're such an adult.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the rest of the day, Gold City seems
to look
at me a little differently from
usual.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I really want to tell you to shut it, but
I'll fight
the urge, just for today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll swing by your office later with some
snacks or
whatever. Not trying to owe
you anything.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ew... You're so done.
choice_data_list: 貸しだけに菓子折りとか……？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I probably shouldn't have said that last
part...
